articles.title: Insects once had 24 legs
articles.snippet: A many-legged creature from long ago helps fill a major gap in the fossil record — and hints at how today’s insects ended up with just six legs.
articles.summary: An ancient many-legged creature helps fill a major gap in the fossil record. This old creature also hints at how today's insects ended up with just six legs.

articles.title: Meet the first new living cat species described in more than a century

articles.title: Analyze This: Color might explain baboon’s link to Egyptian god
articles.snippet: Ancient Egyptians might have linked hamadryas baboons with the moon god Thoth due to their silvery fur.
articles.summary: Ancient Egyptians might have connected hamadryas baboons to the moon god Thoth because of the baboons' silvery fur. This connection shows how the animals' appearance may have influenced ancient beliefs.
